name: sassech-plugins
description: Sassech's Claude Code plugins: a live session sidebar, inline image previews in the transcript, a /sessions manager to list, resume and delete conversations, and per-turn model and effort prefixes

plugins.name: session-sidebar
plugins.description: Live sidebar with session title, model, context, rate limits and MCP servers

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Real image previews in the transcript for pasted images and images Claude reads (kitty graphics protocol)

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: /sessions: list, resume and delete the conversations of the current project

plugins.name: turn-modes
plugins.description: Per-turn overrides by prompt prefix: _ runs the turn and its subagents on the cheap model, + at maximum effort
